brief.tc: 目前有兩個水務暫停，涉及中西區和九龍城區等地。醫院的等待時間中，瑪嘉烈醫院的最長等待時間為五小時，基督教聯合醫院為四個半小時。海灘水質評級中，有十七個海灘的水質為第二級，二十三個海灘的水質為第一級。空氣質素指數為五，風速最高為時速四十公里。
brief.en: There are currently two water supply suspensions affecting Central and Western District and Kowloon City District. The longest waiting time at hospitals is five hours at Margaret Hospital, and four and a half hours at Christian Alliance Hospital. In beach water quality grading, seventeen beaches are rated level two, and twenty-three beaches are rated level one. The air quality health index is five, with a maximum wind speed of forty kilometers per hour.
